scope: same pinned environment; real ASGI startup/native list/chat with only model transport replaced; live RSS snapshots; five fresh processes per scene/state
collection_order: five sequential fresh processes per scene/state; state order rotated each round; no OS cache flush; no concurrent project tests/builds
limitations: Fresh processes and temporary HOME/config each run; no OS page-cache flush or machine-load isolation. Timing/RSS are local observations, not universal performance guarantees.
All network/process launches denied. Vendor probe counts are attempted detection; successful vendor process count is zero by construction in both revisions.
Only model output/transport is fixed; actual native Workspace, Runtime, Agent streaming and persisted user+assistant history are verified. No real vendor account or paid model was exercised.
Plugin enabled metadata is sampled after actual catalog activation; startup_ready and plugin_ready are separate. Frontend browser-body-byte evidence is separate from these measurements.
The before source is an original full Git archive; after source is the uncommitted final source identified by its captured fingerprint, not by HEAD alone.
